lead.headline: Up 21, but Tuten hurt on the first snap
lead.deck: 53% with Daniels on Monday. Nothing can be moved; Tuten's diagnosis decides Week 12.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten, your FLEX, aggravated his foot/ankle on Jacksonville's first play and limped off (NBC; Heavy); Rice, on the bench, finished with 11.3. Likely was active but has nothing yet. You lead KEI returns 62.9 to 42.0, 53% by ESPN, with Daniels to play Monday. Pickens' 23.8 made the bye-forced start right. Jacobs is iffy for Week 12 and Marks is still in concussion protocol.
